const numbers: number[] = [];
if (numbers === []) console.log("empty");
const objectValue = {a: 1};
if (objectValue == {a: 1}) console.log("same");
if (numbers !== []) console.log("different");
const numeric = Number("a");
if (numeric === NaN) console.log("NaN");
if (Number.NaN != numeric) console.log("NaN");
let numericValue = 5;
let textValue = "5";
if (numericValue == textValue) console.log("equal");
if (textValue != numericValue) console.log("different");
